description: This file generates lookup tables for Gaussian distribution used in the Abseil C++ library, specifically for the ziggurat method of generating Gaussian random variables. It defines a class to create and print these tables, and contains a main function that outputs the generated code.

classes.name: TableGenerator
classes.description: A class that generates and prints lookup tables for Gaussian distribution using the ziggurat method.

methods.name: TableGenerator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the tables for the ziggurat algorithm.

methods.name: Print
methods.description: Outputs the generated tables as C++ code to the provided output stream.
